title: Structural Characterization of Hypoxia Inducible Factor alpha-Prolyl Hydroxylase Domain 2 Interaction through MD Simulations.
authors: Camagni, Giorgia F; Minervini, Giovanni; Tosatto, Silvio C E
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟表征PHD2与HIF-α亚型的结合特性，虽涉及转录因子HIF-α的蛋白-蛋白互作，但核心是酶-底物识别而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离本课题。
abstract: The Prolyl Hydroxylases (PHDs) are an enzymatic family that regulates cell oxygen-sensing. PHDs hydroxylate hypoxia-inducible transcription factors alpha (HIFs-alpha) driving their proteasomal degradation. Hypoxia inhibits PHDs activity, inducing HIFs-alpha stabilization and cell adaptation to hypoxia. As a hallmark of cancer, hypoxia promotes neo-angiogenesis and cell proliferation. PHD isoforms are thought to have a variable impact on tumor progression. All isoforms hydroxylate HIF-alpha (HIF-1,2,3alpha) with different affinities. However, what determines these differences and how they pair with tumor growth is poorly understood. Here, molecular dynamics simulations were used to characterize the PHD2 binding properties in complexes with HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha. In parallel, conservation analysis and binding free energy calculations were performed to better understand PHD2 substrate affinity. Our data suggest a direct association between the PHD2 C-terminus and HIF-2alpha that is not observed in the PHD2/HIF-1alpha complex. Furthermore, our results indicate that phosphorylation of a PHD2 residue, Thr405, causes a variation in binding energy, despite the fact that this PTM has only a limited structural impact on PHD2/HIFs-alpha complexes. Collectively, our findings suggest that the PHD2 C-terminus may act as a molecular regulator of PHD's activity.
abstract_zh: 脯氨酰羟化酶（PHDs）是一个调控细胞氧感知的酶家族。PHDs 羟化缺氧诱导转录因子α（HIFs-alpha），促使其经蛋白酶体降解。缺氧抑制 PHDs 活性，诱导 HIFs-alpha 稳定化及细胞对缺氧的适应。作为癌症的一个标志，缺氧促进新生血管生成和细胞增殖。PHD 同工型被认为对肿瘤进展具有不同影响。所有同工型均以不同亲和力羟化 HIF-alpha（HIF-1,2,3alpha）。然而，决定这些差异的因素及其与肿瘤生长的关联尚不清楚。本研究采用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来表征 PHD2 与 HIF-1alpha 和 HIF-2alpha 复合物中的结合特性。同时，进行了保守性分析和结合自由能计算，以更深入理解 PHD2 底物亲和力。我们的数据表明，PHD2 C 末端与 HIF-2alpha 之间存在直接关联，而这种关联在 PHD2/HIF-1alpha 复合物中未观察到。此外，我们的结果表明，PHD2 残基 Thr405 的磷酸化导致结合能变化，尽管该翻译后修饰 (PTM) 对 PHD2/HIFs-alpha 复合物的结构影响有限。总体而言，我们的发现提示 PHD2 C 末端可能作为 PHD 活性的分子调节因子。
